morbi.headline: Morbi tile makers face margin pressures from propane hikes despite strong housing demand.
what_changed: Morbi ceramic manufacturers are considering strategic shifts and passing on price adjustments due to rising propane costs.
Industry units organized a boycott against Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL) to oppose recent propane price increases.
The overall tile sector is experiencing strong housing demand and outperforming peer segments on pricing.
stress_signals: Propane fuel price hikes impacting input costs for Morbi ceramic units [6396a32f35e0]
Morbi ceramic industry boycotting IOCL over contested propane price increases [a7d86eb38db4]
improvement_signals: Tile sector outperforming peers driven by price hikes and robust housing demand [edc2b0a0e70b]
what_to_watch: Resolution of the IOCL propane boycott and potential supply disruptions to kiln operations.
Impact of propane price increases on borrower working capital cycles and operating margins.
Ability of MSME tile units to successfully pass on fuel cost hikes to end consumers amid housing demand.

surat.headline: Surat textiles gain international order diversion amid local payment default and diamond cost pressures.
what_changed: Global brands turning to Surat due to Bangladesh unrest, while 25,000 rural women actively stitch garments for international buyers.
Textile segment expects a 15-20% demand boost from the wedding season alongside easing MMF yarn prices.
Lab-grown diamond segment faces margin pressure after Chinese HPHT rough prices increased by 10%.
stress_signals: Rising incidents of payment defaults and fraud prompt SGCCI to demand Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) amendments [c3927b4b71cd].
Mota Varachha broker defrauds a Katargam trader of 1,035.15 carats of polished diamonds worth Rs 1.27 crore [e8488d4182be].
Threat of an additional 9.74% tax burden on textiles if the machinery duty exemption is not extended to 2032 [c4aec41167e8].
Fire outbreak at a textile unit in Sachin GIDC, Surat [386760347e06].
improvement_signals: Around 100 global garment brands directing interest toward Surat amidst Bangladesh unrest [084fb4124b58].
Surat textile units projecting 15-20% growth driven by the upcoming marriage season [ee10e4ca8235].
Global retail brands Zara and H&M shifting Rs 2,360 crore textile orders to India [4a8371f615d7].
what_to_watch: Implementation of BNS amendments or legal protections against multi-crore payment defaults in local textile markets.
Impact of 10% higher Chinese HPHT rough prices on working capital requirements for lab-grown diamond polishers.
Extent of order conversion and factory-level utilization from redirected international garment buyers.
